Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 35

“Knowing this, you will not fall into such delusion again, Pandava. By it you will see all beings without exception in yourself, and then in me.”

The promised result is perceptual, not doctrinal. Arjuna will see the people on this field differently, which is the only thing that could actually resolve his morning.
